reference.space: flat homogeneous periodic dust cell; V0 fixed; Lambda=0; c=1
reference.boundary_condition: Dirichlet for benchmark only; physical choice not derived
reference.initial_density_operator: OPEN; early state must be normalized, with independently fixed spread
reference.numerical_check: finite Dirichlet interval (0,5), 16 and 32 sine modes; kappa=hbar=1

cst_candidate.measure_proposal: equal arbitrary labeled contributions divided by allowed label group volume
cst_candidate.marked_weight: 1/abs(Aut_boundary(C,fields)) under specified invariant base matter measure
cst_candidate.natural_label_correction: 1/L(C) per natural labeled copy for unmarked quotient target
cst_candidate.variable_n_sector_factors: OPEN; zeta_n must be fixed independently

gates.criterion: Do not mix measure, state amplitude and classical probability; quotient under correct mark-preserving group
Freeze normalized early state, mass sector, ordering, boundaries, readout windows
Specify full CST carrier, sector weights, matter measure, total action and boundary data
Positive normalized decoherence functional and consistent composition
Match classical contracting dust and reduced kernel at low curvature
Control coarse fibres, omitted contributions and physical refinement
Only after upstream gates evaluate new independent bounce data

stop_rule: Reject or hold the specific measure if normalization, composition, classical limit or refinement fail; no tuning to B
